subject: Andriy Shevchenko
title: Shevchenko: exactly the division it deserves

lines.vo: Shevchenko says Ukraine is in exactly the division it deserves. Refreshing honesty.
lines.footage: Shevchenko UAF press conference or interview clip

lines.vo: Third in a four-team group. Euro 2028 seeding? Gone.
lines.footage: Nations League group B table graphic and highlights

lines.vo: Seven points from six games: two wins, one draw, three defeats.
Against Northern Ireland: seventy-three percent of the ball, two shots on target. Northern Ireland had the goals. Three-nil.
lines.footage: Northern Ireland v Ukraine Nations League match highlights

lines.vo: Coach Maldera says he has not even discussed resigning. Yet.
Shevchenko won the Ballon d'Or in 2004. Twenty-four goals in thirty-two Serie A games. Ukraine's table could use a few.
lines.footage: Shevchenko Milan 2004 Serie A goals compilation

lines.vo: Last month in London he handed Lamine Yamal the Young Talent award.
lines.footage: Ballon d'Or 2026 ceremony London, Yamal award clip

lines.vo: Yamal has three of those trophies. Ukraine has seven points.
